 , an AI\\-powered platform for IRDAI\\-licensed life insurance advisors in India. Advisors use it to generate data\\-backed financial reports, manage clients, and convert prospects — work that today is done manually, inconsistently, or not at all.

 . The web platform is live at dash.advicesahi.com, the Android app is in final development, and we are onboarding advisors across Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Delhi NCR.

 The role
 
 You will own product and engineering end to end.
 



 Not "lead a squad within a larger org" — own it. What gets built, how it gets built, whether it ships, and whether it works once it does. Today that responsibility sits with the founder. It should sit with you.
 



**What you'll be responsible for:** 



* The full product surface: the advisor platform, the internal employee portal, and the Android app
* Translating business problems into product decisions, then into shipped software
* Architecture, code quality, database design, security and performance
* Running and mentoring a team of interns — reviewing their work, setting standards, making them useful faster than they'd get there alone
* Release management: what ships, when, and what happens when something breaks in production
* Working directly with the founder on roadmap, and directly with our BD team on what advisors actually need



**Current stack:** 
 Next.js, Supabase (Postgres), Vercel, React Native for mobile. Anthropic APIs for the AI layer. You will inherit real production code with real users on it.
 


 Who we're looking for
 
**Must have:** 



* 2–5 years building and shipping web products, with real ownership of at least one thing that went to production and stayed there
* Strong hands\\-on engineering — you write code every day, not just review it
* Working fluency with AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or equivalent). We build with them daily and expect you to be faster because of them, not merely familiar with them
* Sound judgement on the boring\\-but\\-critical parts: authentication, row\\-level security, data privacy, migrations that don't lose data
* The instinct to ask "should we build this?" before "how do we build this?"



**Strong plus:** 



* Fintech, insurance or wealth\\-management domain exposure
* Mobile release experience (Play Store, app review, versioning)
* Having worked somewhere with no dedicated QA, no DevOps team, and no one to escalate to
* Experience mentoring juniors or interns



**You'll do well here if:** 



* You are comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room, including on days when that's uncomfortable
* You'd rather ship something imperfect on Friday than something perfect next month, but you know which things are not allowed to be imperfect
* You can hold a conversation with a 50\\-year\\-old insurance advisor in Thrissur about why the report generation is confusing, and then go fix it


 Being straight with you about two things
 
**There is real monetary compensation, and it is below market.** 
 You will be paid a fixed monthly salary — enough to live on comfortably in Coimbatore and cover your commitments without stress. This is not an equity\\-only or deferred\\-pay role, and we are not asking you to fund us with your savings. What we cannot match is what a larger company would pay someone of your experience. If cash compensation is your primary consideration right now, this is not the right role, and we'd rather you knew that from this paragraph than from the third interview.
 



**The ESOP is the point.** 
 You would be joining as our technical lead at a stage where that means something. The equity grant will be meaningful, with a clear vesting schedule that we will discuss openly and put in writing. You are trading cash today for ownership of something you will have substantially built.
 



 We are also going to work you hard. This is a startup with an aggressive roadmap, a live product, and paying users — and there will be weeks where that shows.
 


 What you get
 * Genuine ownership of an entire product, not a component of one
* A direct line to the founder and to the business — you will understand why you're building what you're building
* Freedom to choose tools, set standards and shape the engineering culture from the start, because there isn't one yet
* Interns to build a team around
* The chance to see a product go from a few hundred advisors to a few thousand, and to have been the reason it held up


 How to apply
 
 Send the following to :venkatesh@advicesahi.com
 


1. Your CV or LinkedIn
2. A link to something you've built — GitHub, a live product, anything real
3. A short note answering:
 **what's the hardest production bug you've shipped a fix for, and what did you get wrong before you got it right?**



 Please write the note yourself. We will be able to tell, and we're more interested in how you think than in how well you prompt.
 


* **Process:** 
 an intake call with the founder, a take\\-home task on a real problem from our backlog, a technical deep\\-dive on your solution, and a final conversation on scope, equity and expectations.
